compliance_boundary.is_legal_clearance_explanation_en: This ledger is an author-self registry of asset licenses, usage boundaries, and attribution requirements across nine asset classes. It is NOT a legal clearance opinion or professional IP certification, and does NOT substitute independent legal advice.
compliance_boundary.external_ip_rights_state: All third-party assets used in the package are limited to open-source licenses (SIL OFL 1.1, Apache-2.0) or system fonts distributed with the OS; no commercial third-party imagery, photography, or proprietary data is redistributed.
compliance_boundary.publication_scope: COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY: gallery display, academic citation, peer discussion, and review by the open-source submission organizer. Not for commercial development, government approval materials, or implied government endorsement.
compliance_boundary.per_path_reconciliation_state_zh: 已完成 105/105 路径的逐路径权利与双语对账（per_path_rights_registry）。该结论为作者自我登记，不构成法律不侵权保证或法律清权意见。
compliance_boundary.per_path_reconciliation_state_en: Per-path rights and bilingual reconciliation completed for 105/105 paths (per_path_rights_registry). This is an author-self registry and is NOT a legal non-infringement guarantee or legal clearance opinion.

per_path_rights_registry.schema_note_zh: 逐路径权利登记：本包 105 个交付文件逐项登记 sha256、资产类别、权利基础、处置决定、可否再分发与是否含第三方内容。与 assets[] 的九类资产清单一并使用：本表提供文件级粒度，assets[] 提供许可条款与署名要求。
per_path_rights_registry.schema_note_en: Per-path rights registry: all 105 delivered files are registered individually with sha256, asset class, rights basis, disposition decision, redistribution permission, and third-party content flag. Use together with assets[]: this table gives file-level granularity while assets[] gives licence terms and attribution requirements.
per_path_rights_registry.not_redistributed_note_zh: 标注 redistribution_allowed=false 的文件（PDF / HTML / 图件中内嵌的系统字体）仅在本包内渲染使用，不随包再分发字体文件本身。
per_path_rights_registry.not_redistributed_note_en: Files marked redistribution_allowed=false (system typefaces embedded in PDF / HTML / figures) are used for in-package rendering only; the font files themselves are not redistributed with the package.
